human_review_flags.description: Lloyd's List Aug 17-23 weekly data (16.3/day) nominally crosses the 15/day resolution threshold, but the 29% discrepancy with TankerMap (~21/day) triggers N7's own ambiguity rule. Monitor IMF PortWatch publication dates. If PortWatch publishes a confirmed ≥15/day 7-day average before Sep 21, resolve YES. Otherwise, prepare AMBIGUOUS pathway.

N8 horizon resolves EOD Sep 1. Full dual-TIER1 attribution chain (IRGC vs. other Iranian-affiliated forces) for the AL SALAM II Aug 26 strike should be verified before EOD Sep 1. If attribution confirmed TIER1-dual before EOD Sep 1, N8 may already be resolved YES; if confirmed NO through Sep 1, resolved NO.
